changes.description: A13 primary statistic: macro-average overall accuracy
changes.implementation: compute_macro_avg_accuracy() in baselines.py computes mean of 4 per-regime accuracies. Explicit macro-averaging ensures each regime contributes equally regardless of per-regime N.
No structural_exemptions dict in A13 gate. always-abstain scores macro-avg=0.25 (chance) without any carve-out: (0+1+0+0)/4 = 0.25.

changes.description: One-sided 95% UCB at runtime via grouped bootstrap
changes.implementation: grouped_family_bootstrap_macro_avg() in baselines.py. 10,000 replicates. UCB = 95th percentile of bootstrap distribution. Gate rule: UCB <= 0.30.

Resampling unit: template family. Stage 1: draw F families with replacement. Stage 2: within each drawn family, within each regime, resample items with replacement. Macro-average recomputed per replicate. Mirrors two-stage protocol in acceptance/bootstrap.py.
Per-regime accuracies reported in runner output and flagged if conspicuous (>0.80), but do NOT independently determine the A13 gate.

TestA13MacroAvgUCB class: (a) macro-avg not pooled, (b) point<0.30 + UCB>0.30 => FAIL, (c) UCB<=0.30 => PASS, (d) accuracy>0.30 => FAIL, (e) always-abstain 0.25 no exemption, (f) per-regime non-gating, (g) grouped family resampling verified.
Exits nonzero if bootstrap or macro-avg computation fails. Frozen test hashes updated. 59 acceptance tests + 23 credential guard tests = 82 total.

a13_definition.statistic: macro-average accuracy = mean(CLEAN_acc, INSUF_acc, DECOY_acc, CONFLICT_acc)
a13_definition.gate_rule_corpus_scale: one-sided 95% UCB (grouped family bootstrap, 10,000 replicates) <= 0.30 (when N >= 30/regime)
a13_definition.gate_rule_sample_scale: completeness + point estimate <= 0.30 (when N < 30/regime; UCB informational only)
a13_definition.ucb_derivation: 95th percentile of bootstrap distribution of macro-average accuracy
a13_definition.tolerance_derivation: one-sided 95% normal-approx UCB at N=500, chance=0.25 ~ 0.282, rounded to 0.30
a13_definition.structural_exemptions: none; always-abstain yields macro-avg=0.25 without any carve-out
